Hi Matt —

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday — great context on transaction volumes and the multi-tenant constraints. Per our brief, the next step that tends to be most useful is a 90-minute hands-on workshop where we:

- validate throughput / latency targets against your peak slice,
- map a proposed serving topology (hosted vs. dedicated vs. hybrid),
- identify key observability and fallback controls for SLA adherence, and
- confirm onboarding constraints (networking, VPC peering, KMS).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu 3/23 09:00–10:30
- Thu 3/23 13:00–14:30
- Fri 3/24 11:00–12:30

Agenda (attached: RDW-inference-workshop-agenda.pdf):
1) 10m goals and success criteria (Aurora)
2) 35m topology & sizing review (Redwood + Aurora numbers)
3) 25m runbook & fallback patterns (SLOs / cold start / cache)
4) 20m open items & next steps + owners

Couple of asks before the session:
- Can you confirm the PK throughput sample (p50/p95 token/sec) and a short list of the model variants you expect to test?
- Please add any colleagues who should attend the topology portion (networking/security/infra).

If none of the times work, tell me two preferred windows and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks — I’ve attached a one-page agenda and a quick topology sketch for reference.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
